## 1. Objective, scope and authority

Objective: demonstrate that [selected users] can follow [bounded concern workflow] and retrieve its evidence. Configure organization, process, sites, sponsor, accountable owner and approval limits. This plan contains no booked sessions or appointed people.

## 2. Activities, resources and dependencies

| Activity | Proposed accountable role | Required input | Completion evidence / trigger |
|---|---|---|---|
| Define scope and prerequisites | Process owner | Existing workflow and actual obligations | Scoped configuration before pilot |
| Configure records and access | Custodian | Retention/access authority and evidence store | Tested permitted access before real intake |
| Brief participants | Facilitator | Current templates and actual role assignments | Actual briefing record before attempt |
| Exercise ordinary and missing-evidence cases | Facilitator and users | Exact input version and consent to document exercise | Actual responses/assistance recorded; no invented results |
| Review findings and retest | Scoped reviewer | Failed/ambiguous attempt and corrected version | Attributable retest before affected acceptance |
| Decide rollout or continued hold | Delegated authority | Scope-specific review and unresolved gaps | Exact-version decision; no automatic rollout |

## 3. Schedule, success and contingency

Set actual dates/resources and dependencies before starting; do not replace them with fictional dates. Success: users identify the right owner/authority, distinguish implementation from outcome, retrieve the correct version and retain missing-evidence holds. Material misunderstanding requires correction and retest. If participants, scope or evidence access are unavailable, record not run and reschedule; no pass from nonparticipation.

## 4. Communication, monitoring and records

Communicate scope, task, assistance rules and reporting route. Track unresolved findings by owner/trigger, with no universal pass percentage. Preserve exact test inputs, actual observations, changes, retests and rollout decision privately. Review on source/scope/user-role changes and at the adopted interval.

## 5. History

r01: original blank learning plan; no actual organizational adoption or trial recorded.
